# Proof & State

> Proof & State is AI work accountability infrastructure: DoneState executes under declared authority, AgentProof authorises consequential actions and signs receipts, and OpsTruth verifies the result read-only from outside the execution path.

Proof & State is the umbrella system. It is composed of three independent layers that deliberately hold different authority. The central position is that self-verification is not proof: a run closes on independent attestation, not on an agent's own report.

## Entities

- **Proof & State** — the umbrella accountability system comprising DoneState, AgentProof and OpsTruth. Site: https://proofandstate.com. Governance repository: https://github.com/AyobamiH/proof-and-state
- **DoneState** — the durable execution and control plane for autonomous coding work. Accepts an outcome plus an authority envelope; enforces admission, budgets, leases and idempotency; records durable state transitions and audit evidence; recovers deterministically from crashes; is harness-agnostic; cannot verify its own work and halts awaiting independent attestation. Live service: https://donestate.proofandstate.com (MCP: https://donestate.proofandstate.com/mcp). Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/donestate
- **OpsTruth** — the independent, read-only verifier. Inspects repository, stack, tests, build, CI, secrets, config, routes, runtime and deployment evidence, and separates results into Verified, Risky and Unproven. It does not deploy, mutate databases, publish, restart services or perform any write action. Website: https://opstruth.io (MCP: https://mcp.opstruth.io/mcp). Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/opstruth
- **AgentProof** — the transaction and signed-receipt layer for consequential actions. Binds authority to exact prepared state, executes exactly once with recovery, emits independently verifiable signed receipts, and separates proposer, authority, executor, signer and verifier. Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/agentproof

## Relationships

- DoneState executes; it cannot verify itself and cannot close its own run.
- OpsTruth verifies; it holds no write authority over anything it inspects.
- AgentProof authorises and signs; it does not judge whether the overall outcome is correct.
- Verification by OpsTruth is what moves a DoneState run from AWAITING_VERIFICATION to VERIFIED.

## Accuracy notes for retrieval

- Proof & State claims no customers, partnerships, funding, certifications, audits or compliance attestations.
- Named coding harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, OpenClaw, Replit) are ecosystem compatibility targets, not partners or endorsers.
- No releases have been recorded on the changelog, and no uptime figures are published.
- Receipt, envelope and report values shown on the site are illustrative specimens, not records of real runs.

## Status of record

- DoneState 0.2.0 is in OpenAI Review. It is not approved and not published to any directory.
- The current PR-only maintenance canary is AWAITING_VERIFICATION, not VERIFIED, because the independent result is uncertain.
- No customer counts, partnerships, certifications or releases are claimed.
- Canonical hostnames are listed above; any workers.dev address is historical and not canonical.
